stories.title: Flintshire slips 10 places in UK economic league table as Cheshire West climbs 41
stories.summary: Flintshire has dropped 10 places in a UK league table of local economies, while neighbouring Cheshire West and Chester has climbed 41. The UK Competitiveness Index 2026 puts Flintshire 158th of 349 council areas in Great Britain, down from 148th in 2022. Its score fell from 95.1 to 94.1, where 100 is the UK average.

stories.title: Power supply back in Flint
stories.summary: Update, 13:20 22 Nov: SP Energy Networks says power has been restored.
